purpose.zh: 拉开大腿内侧和后面，在办公室就能做
purpose.en: Stretches your inner thighs and the backs of your thighs, right at the office.

text.zh: 背拉长，两手扶椅面，上身往前倾
text.en: Long back, hands on the chair seat, lean forward

text.zh: 两脚分很宽，脚尖朝前，膝盖伸直别锁死。
text.en: Feet very wide, toes forward, knees straight but soft.

text.zh: 胸口往椅子那边送，大腿内侧和后面都有拉的感觉就停。
text.en: Send your chest toward the chair. Stop when you feel your inner and back thighs.

text.zh: 呼气时屁股再往后推一点，胸口跟着往下。
text.en: Each breath out, push your hips back a little and let your chest follow.

commonErrors.en: Rounding your back and reaching for the floor.

commonErrors.zh: 两手撑着椅子往下压肩膀
commonErrors.en: Pushing down through your hands into the chair.

cautions.zh: 起身慢一点，头晕就先停
cautions.en: Come up slowly. If you feel dizzy, stop.

cautions.zh: 拉的地方疼就少往前倾点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If the stretch hurts, don't lean as far. Stop if it still hurts.
